body:
## What it does

Starts by getting your sizes and your taste on record, then goes looking for pieces that are actually in stock and fit that formula. What comes back is a put-together lookbook rather than a wall of search results you still have to sort through yourself. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @clairevo shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
